==About me==

Hello, I'm Leyrann. This is a fictive name, not my real name. I'm 15 years old and I live in the Netherlands. As to be expected from someone who has an account on this wikia, my favorite books are those of the Wheel of Time. My hobbies are playing computer games, improving this wikia (this hobby came when I first found it), writing stories (epic fantasy of course) and listining music. My favourite music is (power-)metal, but I also like rock. My favourite bands are Blind Guardian, that has made two songs about the Wheel of Time (Wheel of Time and Ride into Obsession) and DragonForce. And on 14 june, my birthday, I made edit 100 (this one).



==My WoT reading==
I started reading WoT just one year ago - somewhere early May 2010. First, I read the prolouge (which was probably a bad idea) and after that, I started in tEotW. I didn't like it so much at first, but when I was reading in the appendix, I saw Siuan Sanche was Amyrlin Seat, and I wanted to know more about it. So I read on until the start of TGH. And then I wanted to know what was going to happen next. And when I read the story at Wikipedia (a bad idea that turned out well), I read that Verin was Black Ayah. So I read on, lend the books from my brother, and in August I read until KoD. But my brother didn't have TGS. So I went to the bookshop and bought a book, for the first time in my life. That midday and evening I read, and the whole next day, until twenty to three in the night. The day after it would be the last day of the vacation, but I finished until where I could. Some months later, in November, I read a book in English for the first time - Towers of Midnight. And now I'm waiting for A Memory of Light. As most people who read this will be.


==Planning==
Nothing. I'm too much on other WoT sites. I'm doing only a little bit here each day, and I think I will become REALLY active when I've read AMoL.

==Funny Extra's==
There are some things that I would like very much, which could happen at aMoL, but are not important for the plot, as Fortuona becoming Aes Sedai would be. Here is my list (it will expand in time) (A part of these is from Dragonmount. These have "DM" at the end):
*[[Reene Harfor]] and [[Halwin Norry]] who fell in love with each other and get married.
*[[Lanfear|Lanfear/Cyndane]] survives the Last Battle and falls in love with someone of Rand's side. Talmanes, for example (I first had Logain. But he has already bounded two Aes Sedai).
*The Ta'veren explain to each other how to interact with the opposite sex. (DM)
*Bela becomes famous because she carried 1. The Dragon Reborn 2. The Amyrlin Seat and 3. The former Amyrlin Seat. (DM)

==Demandred==
Mayor change. I was first talking about possibilities. Then I thought "His rule is secure. So he has power. It rules out many characters. Let's see who are in power." Well, I thought that in Dutch of course. But I had a look:
*Borderlands - Ethinelle, Tenobia, Easar, Paitar
*Andor, Cairhien - Elayne
*Illian, Tear - Rand
*Altara, Amadicia, Tarabon - Fortuona
*Gheldean, Arad Doman - no one
*Morland - Roedran
So, these are all countries in Randland. And because RJ said in 2001 we were able to find out who he was, he has to be mentioned in the first nine books. Where can't he be in power? The Borderlands, Andor, Cairhien, Illian, Tear, Altara, Amadicia, Tarabon, Gheldean, Arad Doman. The leaders of all those countries have appeared. Demandred did not (except for maybe in TGS). So, only Murandy is left. DEMANDRED IS KING ROEDRAN!!!!!!!!!!!!
